data.name: Steal Secret
data.description: A secret broker learns how to steal a secret from an unwilling target. This works as her share memory ability, except it allows her to access memories from unwilling targets. A target that succeeds at its saving throw against a secret broker's steal secret ability is forever after immune to that secret broker's steal secret ability. While this ability replaces magic circles, the secret broker can still use outside contact, though she leverages the outsider's secrets rather than create a circle. It still takes 1 minute to call it (the same length of time it normally takes to draw the circle) and costs 2 points of mental focus, even though she isn't using magic circles.
